name: Tourist Entry / e-Visa

requirements.blocker_text: Burkina Faso's official e-visa portal (Division de la Migration) requires all foreigners to present a valid passport or laissez-passer/refugee travel document, an entry visa (or visa waiver/permit/residence permit where exempted), health documentation per international health regulations, proof of return transport or a repatriation deposit (unless exempted), and a completed migration control form. E-visas are applied for online at applicant.visaburkina.bf.
requirements.fix_path: For non-exempt nationalities, apply for an e-visa online through the official Visa Burkina portal before travel.

evidence_required.document: Proof of return transport or repatriation deposit

sources.title: Visa Burkina (official e-visa portal, Division de la Migration, Government of Burkina Faso) -- entry conditions: passport/visa/health/return-transport/migration-form requirements
